verdict.rationale: Opting out of AI model training is a fair privacy question for a SaaS financial platform like Airwallex, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a data-use policy for model training, or any related control. The AI-related docs cover agent toolkits, MCP servers, the CLI and scoped API keys, none of which address training-data use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
